steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Here. Gavial told me you're with Rhodes Island too.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: My lieutenants are all businessmen. I've taught them a little Sargonian. Talk to them if you need anything.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Alright. But why's that one staring at me?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: We don't get many guests here, so it's a bit of an occasion.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: It is for me, at least!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Look at that tail!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Long and fleshy... It looks so soft and flexible too... Are those orange patterns on it?

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Look, she's carrying all that stuff with her tail! And lifting that heavy door with one hand! Wow!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: She must be really good at wrestling. That tail looks like it could break a tree in half. She's so beautiful!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: I've never seen someone like that. I wanna be friends with her!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Wait, you're going up to her just like that? I, I'm not sure... whoa...

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Metal Crab armor, Metal Crab greaves! Their hard shells stop any attack!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Sawfin tooth hammer and Sawfin bone sword! Their sharp edges cut through anything!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: (She's coming...!)

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Hey, hello!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Something wrong?

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Oh! Well, I like your tail!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: My tail? The hell are you talking about?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: I'm busy. Outta my way!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: (Whoa! She's scary...)

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Oh, wait!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: No need to be angry, right? I said I like you!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: What about you? Don't you think my tail's nice? People say I've got a cool tail!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Ha? What're you on about now?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Go play in the mud with your friend.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: You speak our language? In a pretty rowdy way, though...

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: I'm not playing in the mud! Did you think I'm a kid or something?

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: ...We'll have a fight!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Seriously, what's wrong with you?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Outta my way!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Are you nuts?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Fine, you're nice, your tail's nice, super nice!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Oh? C'mon, gimme a break!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: It's a fight!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Hey, watch out—woo, that's right, get your tail round her neck!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Oh no, my oil—hey, that was neat, using oil to slip out!

steps.name: Group of Archosauria
steps.text: Woo! Fight! Fight!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Quick, this bush will hide us.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Haven't you guys fought enough yesterday? Why do I have to be here too?

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: And what about you two?

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: She bought a bunch of stuff. Of course we want to check it out.

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: She took a few scales off my tail last time!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: She bought all that stuff, but she's living in a shed out here instead of in the village?

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Not a bad spot though. That tree isn't too far from the river, but not so close that it would get flooded.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: S-She caught a huge bug!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: She's frying it!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: She's putting it on bread!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: She ate it!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Ughh...

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Look at her, she's putting rocks in her soup.

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: That's the kind of salty rock that gives it more flavor. How did she know about them? I don't think anyone in the village told her.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Hey, she knows about those vines that you told me about too. The ones that have a tangy sweetness when you chew them.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Is she going out to catch fins?

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Maybe striped fins, but sawfins aren't so easy to catch. I've caught a few with my tail, but it hurts quite a bit.

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Maybe outsiders can learn about the rocks and vines, but when it comes to fins—

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Ha!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: How did she do that?

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Pff.

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Let's go and find some vines.
Two hours later

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Um, uh...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Still tailing me? Did you think I didn't see you?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: What about your friend? Eaten by fins?

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Er, no, she saw you eat the bugs and got hungry too, but—

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Looks like she ate the wrong kind!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: C-Can you help us out?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Eh?!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: What is WRONG with you people?

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: It was because you ate them...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: So what kind did she eat? How many?

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Not sure... and just a few.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Did she vomit? Is she conscious? Are there any spots on her skin? Swelling?

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Forget it, I'll take a look myself.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: No fever, no rashes. Take this herb and boil it in water. It'll make her throw up.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Give her plenty of water.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: She threw up three times until there was nothing left, then fell asleep.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Is she gonna be okay?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Just give her more water and stop yapping already!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: The fire is so warm.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: I want to sing.

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Heh, me too!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: We love a muscle that's big and whole~♪

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: You farm, and I hunt~ There's teeth white and tough in my little runts~♪

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Hey!♪

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Seriously, why are you people still here? What am I, your mom?

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Are you saying you're our mother? What do you mean?

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Maybe it's the tail? She's got a tail too. Maybe we're relatives!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Where are you from, Mom?

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: W-Why do you eat bugs, Mom?

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: And why come here? You bought my stuff too. Are you gonna live here?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Just— *Sigh*... I...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: I'm not your mom, and I'm here to climb the waterfall.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: You've gotta be kidding, no one's ever climbed it!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Then why are you climbing it? You'll die! And what for? Are there more fins up there?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: ...For the view.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: The view? From the waterfall? Can't you find those anywhere?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: It's exciting. Climbing it'll be fun.

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: What? How is that exciting? We're happy enough just living here and getting our three meals a day.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Yeah, this is where we live. Plus, what if there's a bunch of poisonous bugs up there? You'll die! That's not exciting.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Yeah, you'll die! Don't be silly!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: We saw you eat bugs. Did you spend all your money shopping a few days ago? But you can make money if you catch a bunch of fins!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Yeah, follow Inam and you'll make lots of money!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: And your parents will be sad if you die!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Parents? They ain't around anymore.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: But what's with all this death talk? Never said I was gonna die.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Oh, that's good.

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Then let's keep singing! Do you want to learn our songs?

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: You farm—♪

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Oh for god's sake stop talking already even that girl wasn't as noisy as you people I should've gotten some duct tape to shut you up for good!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Whoa! What did she say? That wasn't Sargonian, was it?

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Did one of her eyes just change color?

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Argh! Ugh! Uhhhh...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Finally! She's awake! Now you can take her and scram!

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Ugh... guh...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Shit, and out like a light again.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Whatever. You have doctors, don't you? Stop wasting time with me.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Now piss off.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Alright, thank you, miss!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: (Doesn't change the fact that she's weird through. Maybe we should knock her out and take her away in a sack if things don't go well.)

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Hell no!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Oh, it's morning.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Yesterday was so tiring... I should go before those guys come back.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Looks like that's everything. Time to move!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: And here we are.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: It's even more daunting up close. What am I getting myself into?

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Well, here goes nothing!
The surroundings are silent, save for the deafening roar of the waterfall. Asbestos climbs against the raging current, tugging at her rope, the top of which is swallowed by the splashing foam.
It is always the same—climbing towards unknown heights, or descending into unknown depths.
She knows that there is a stunning view at her destination, but not what difficulties that she might encounter on the way.
It could be a slip, a fall, wild beasts, snowstorms, or perhaps some disaster or challenge she could never imagine.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: (The current's too strong. I can't find my footing!)

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: (There's a branch there!)

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: (Good, it's pretty solid. I should be able to avoid the currents by following it...)

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Ha!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: So slippery!
She knows how it feels to lose her balance in rapid currents, pushing her lungs to the limit in suffocating whirlpools.
She knows how it feels to keep climbing through the night after breaking her arm from a fall halfway up, just to catch a glimpse of the sunrise from the top.
She knows how it feels to slip and fall on a glacier, the ice chips ripping through her skin.
But she also remembers seeing the rays of the setting sun reflect upon the icy surface when she stood up again, accompanied by a sweet icy breeze.
At that moment, Asbestos no longer cared about her bleeding wounds. All the pain and suffering, all the hardship—it was all worth it.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: *Cough* *Cough*...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Aye, that was one hell of a shower... good thing there's a gap here.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: But I'm still alive! And almost there!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Here we go!
Every time she gets up again, she is thinking the same thing.
It was bloody worth it.
Half an hour later

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: *gasp*... *gasp*...

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: I'm exhausted...

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: I took a look around. No poisonous bugs, so she won't die. Oh, and these vines grow here too? Wow, there's a lot of them!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: It's such a great place up here! So many vines growing here!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Haha, you may be fierce, but you're pretty darn good!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Hey, back off!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: I had my eyes on her first!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Oh, and sorry about the other day. Kanna told me you outsiders don't like fighting. I shouldn't have hit you.

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: But your tail is really cool!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Oh, for the love of—!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Just shut up and take in the view!
The Archosauria are wet and muddy, with pieces of grass in their hair.
A wind from the canyon blows the grass into the sky, until it disappears in the distance.
They see a sight they have never seen before—their own home.

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Look over there!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Wow! Look at that!

Their hearts are filled with myriad emotions. Beautiful, stunning, spectacular—or perhaps something beyond what any word could describe. Just like the outsider who gazes at the view in fascination, their cries of joy echo through the canyon.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Woo!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Wahoo!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: It's beautiful.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: I want to sing.

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Let's surround her! Join hands and sing!

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: Your waterfall is rushing, there's fins for your plate~♪

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: You swing about your tail, so the fins take the bait~♪

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Climb up your waterfall, it's such a pretty sight~♪

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: It's such a pretty sight, oh, such a pretty sight~♪

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Ha. Fine.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Such a pretty sight~♪

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Hey, stop spinning!

steps.name: Frank Archosauria
steps.text: Cheer and laugh, till we make the sky sing~♪

steps.name: Shy Archosauria
steps.text: Make the sky sing~♪

steps.name: Happy Archosauria
steps.text: We'll be going!

steps.name: Serious Archosauria
steps.text: Goodbye, friend!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, later guys!

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: So tired.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Where do they get the energy for all that noise? I'd rather climb ten waterfalls.

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: Now, what should I write for this one?
One month later

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Magazine delivery from Asbestos! There's one for everyone! Her travel journal's inside.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: A travel journal is a record you keep of what you see and experience when you visit a new place.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Wow, she grades the sights pretty harshly. And she looked so happy when she came down from the waterfall.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: It's in Rim Billitonian. I'll translate it. There's a new section: 'Meet the Locals.' You guys are in it!

steps.name: Group of Archosauria
steps.text: We're in a book!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Ahem! It opens like this:

steps.name: Asbestos
steps.text: 'They're noisy, but fun.'
